Francesca Tozzi will open Brach Roma, the first Rome address of @Evok Hôtels Collection, as general manager.

She has been in post since 1 October to lead the pre-opening. The hotel is due in the first quarter of 2027.

Brach Roma takes over a former school of about 5,000 square metres, 100 metres from Piazza del Popolo. It will have 58 rooms and suites, a rooftop, a restaurant with a patio and a sport and wellness club with a 25-metre pool. Philippe Starck leads the art direction, as he did for Brach Paris.

The signal: Evok is exporting its Parisian lifestyle model to Rome. Appointing the GM months before opening shows how much a launch depends on the team built before day one.

Congratulations, Francesca, on this new role.

How early should a general manager join a new hotel?

Read the full article: https://hospitality-signals.com/new-in-post/2026-10-21-francesca-tozzi-brach-roma/
